title: Ichigo Struggles Against Yhwach in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 45 Preview
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 5 (Episode 45 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Matsurika Kanriden' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rinne Ishida 's Matsurika Kanriden ( The Legend of Bureaucrat Matsurika ) light novel revealed additional cast, staff, the opening theme, and first promotional video on Friday.

title: Matsurika Kanriden Releases New Trailer Featuring Opening Theme Song by Kana Boon
content: The previously announced Matsurika Kanriden anime released a new trailer featuring the opening thems song “Hana Hanashi” by Kana Boon. The anime is slated to broadcast in January 2027 with Maho Film in charge of the animation. Rie Takahashi stars as Matsurika Ko and Nobunaga Shimazaki as Emperor Hakuyo.

title: 'Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, 2027 Premiere
content: An official website opened for the television anime adaptation of Nikita Kitagawa 's Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe wo Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Houshuu wo Mugen Kaishuu Dekimashita! light novel on Friday and revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured).

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Reveals Cour 2 Visual, Heroines Cover Mrs. GREEN APPLE's "Ao to Natsu"
content: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle anime revealed a new key visual for its second cour, ahead of the anime’s October 2026 return. The first cour concluded in March. Studio feel. is in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage Anime Reveals First Visual and Trailer, Cast, January 2027 Release
content: A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage anime revealed the first teaser visual and trailer, along with the main cast and January 2027 release date. Takaaki Ishiyama is directing the anime at EMT Squared, with Shigeru Murakoshi handling the series composition.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shinichi Sawaragi 's Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon ( A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 First Trailer Revealed
content: A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special Season 2 revealed a new trailer ahead of its October 2026 release date. Studio Arvo Animation is back to animate, with Taishi Kawaguchi returning as director. The anime previously revealed that FLOW will again be in charge of the opening theme .
author: Anime Corner

title: Shota Oni Anime Titled Ore to Yu-nii! Reveals Teaser Trailer, January 2027 Release
content: The anime adaptation of Miyuki Nakayama’s Shota Oni , titled Ore to Yuu-nii! , revealed a teaser trailer and January 2027 release. Noriko Hashimoto is directing the anime at Studio Hibari, with Yuniko Ayana handling the series composition. Yumi Kuroiwa serves as character designer and chief animation director.
author: Anime Corner
